## Objective

Collect actual production security, offline, accessibility, nonmutation, performance and comprehension evidence.

## Scope

- Verify dedicated service security and isolation
- Verify actual production offline user workflows
- Record keyboard and assistive technology acceptance
- Prove end-to-end browsing nonmutation
- Benchmark bounded representative and pathological workloads
- Validate comprehension with people

## Entry conditions

- Phase 4 complete; actual production bundle built through authorized steps.

## Exit criteria

- Every targeted production acceptance result is classified; mandatory security/semantic defects corrected and rerun; environment limits disclosed.

## Risks

- Screenshots/scanners/unit tests do not establish complete production use; proposed targets remain qualified.

## TASK-020 - Verify dedicated service security and isolation

Run adversarial request/asset/source/session tests and runtime import/call audits against the built reader and simultaneous selected projects.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-026, REQ-028, REQ-029, REQ-030, REQ-031, REQ-032, REQ-033, REQ-038, REQ-043 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/ontology/tests/test_explorer_security.py, Verification/project-knowledge-explorer-first-release/security-results.json |
| Dependencies | TASK-019 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- None

### Acceptance criteria

- AT-24, AT-25, AT-26, AT-27 pass with direct old-write requests, hostile scope/credentials, traversal/symlink/oversized files and malicious labels/source links, while protected bytes remain unchanged.
- No generic dispatch, optional service invocation, runtime secret leakage, broad CORS, arbitrary source/asset access or cross-project route/session/cache data exists.

### Planned verification

- Run targeted HTTP suites with two namespaces and one shared label/different meanings; exercise resource exhaustion, bounded retry and safe failures.
- Inspect import/call graph for authoring/provisioning/build/wiki/memory functions; instrument forbidden operations to fail if invoked.
- Record an individual observed result and exact evidence locator for each scenario: AT-24, AT-25, AT-26, AT-27. Aggregate suite success does not replace per-scenario evidence.

### Risks

- None

### Acceptance criteria

- AT-29, AT-30, labeled search/combobox behavior, visible unobscured focus, contrast and applicable 24px target exceptions have specific evidence.
- Actual browser/AT versions include macOS VoiceOver/Safari; Windows combination is tested when available or its non-exercise is explicit.
- A scanner pass is never an unqualified WCAG compliance claim and diagram exception never excuses surrounding text/control reflow.

### Planned verification

- Run automated accessibility checks on all destinations, states and both themes.
- Manually follow search, entry, sources, map/list, menus, Escape/focus return, narrow/zoom and reduced-motion tasks; retain exact environments and failures.
- Record an individual observed result and exact evidence locator for each scenario: AT-29, AT-30. Aggregate suite success does not replace per-scenario evidence.

### Acceptance criteria

- AT-33 establishes unchanged ontology/source configuration, memory data/config, proposals, publication receipts and generated products across all reads.
- Only exact documented startup session/runtime files and harmless preference keys are exempt; no broad .sys4ai exemption exists.
- Opening evidence never repairs source hashes and stale/missing wiki never triggers rebuild or blocks definitions.

- Inspect runtime artifacts created by explicit launch and classify every change; unexpected mutations fail the gate.

## TASK-024 - Benchmark bounded representative and pathological workloads

Measure production performance and resource behavior at small, representative and stress fixture shapes with actual hardware/browser/build/limits and cold/warm conditions.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-018, REQ-022, REQ-025, REQ-033, REQ-043, REQ-045, REQ-046 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | Verification/project-knowledge-explorer-first-release/performance-results.json, Verification/project-knowledge-explorer-first-release/performance-protocol.md |
| Dependencies | TASK-003, TASK-021, TASK-023 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- None

### Acceptance criteria

- AT-36 reports repeated-run median and p95, memory, enforced limits and graceful degradation at approximate 50/100, 1000/5000 and 5000/50000 entry/relation targets, with loader capacity measured.
- Proposed 2s cold first-read, warm search p95 200ms excluding debounce, entry p95 250ms, 1.5s focused 25/50 graph and 100ms loaded selection remain reported targets; actual misses remain visible.
- Additional connections leave the old view usable with bounded progress/cancellation; source validation cost and compressed bundle size are measured separately.

### Planned verification

- Run cold/warm repetitions and high-degree/long-definition/many-source/cycles/cancellation fixtures; document sample counts and timing boundaries.
- If profiling shows source validation dominates, test validated immutable reuse before proposing a contract change; never use stale-as-current data to improve timings.
- Record an individual observed result and exact evidence locator for each scenario: AT-36. Aggregate suite success does not replace per-scenario evidence.
- Record the first unsupported loader-capacity threshold with safe bounded failure; do not silently increase shared agent caps to force the stress fixture to load.

## TASK-025 - Validate comprehension with people

Conduct small exploratory production knowledge-task walkthroughs with someone unfamiliar with implementation, or document owner-only walkthrough and broader validation as unperformed.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |

| Dependencies | TASK-021, TASK-022, TASK-024 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- None

### Acceptance criteria

- Participant can attempt find/explain term, distinguish terms, interpret relation endpoints/meaning, visit neighbor/return, understand supported or absent process order and inspect freshness.
- Record completion, wrong turns, mistaken meanings, requests for help and participant wording; 30s known-term target stays proposed and no statistical generalization is made.
- Resolve high-impact reversed-direction or layout-causality misconceptions before claiming usable release; owner-only results state the limitation.

### Planned verification

- Run the named knowledge tasks without implementation vocabulary coaching; record safe concise observations and elapsed time.
- Recheck any high-impact fix through the affected focused browser/semantic/accessibility tests and targeted walkthrough.
